name: No-show / cancel
job: Handle appt_status=no-show and appt_status=cancel only. Reschedule never enters. Drops the contact from WF-03 and re-checks booking.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Added by WF-05 (appt_status no-show or cancel)
named_steps.comment: Sole enroll. Reschedule must never route here.

named_steps.name: REMOVE-FROM-WF: Drop from WF-03 Reminders
named_steps.comment: Stops any in-flight reminder cadence. Must not remove v2_status_booked (booking state is factual).

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on appt_status (no-show | cancel)
named_steps.comment: Split copy paths. Must not tag no-show if source was reschedule.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_appt_no_show (no-show branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 tag. Must not remove live booking tags.

named_steps.name: SMS: Recovery outreach (inline)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Honors quiet hours 8am-9pm contact TZ.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Re-check booking (v2_status_booked)
named_steps.comment: If they booked again, exit without further nudge.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route unbooked to WF-09 Nurture
named_steps.comment: Long-tail nurture. Must not create Sales opps here.
